Name: Allon, Son of Jedaiah
Summary: Son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah in Simeon's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:37: Son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah in Simeon's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Allon stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
